facts.claim: One evidence lane summarizes the cited continual-learning model with PFC-inspired mechanisms.

facts.notes: No task count is shown.

facts.claim: The cited model uses sluggish task units that carry recent contextual information through an exponential moving average.
facts.notes: No undocumented brain topology is depicted.

facts.claim: The cited model adds Hebbian context gating after a standard supervised update.
facts.notes: The artwork omits unsupported circuit geometry.

facts.claim: The cited gating process learns to separate, described in the paper as orthogonalize, different task representations in a hidden layer.

exclusions.reason: Do not combine the three cited research programs into one executable architecture, pipeline, or automatic feedback loop.
Do not imply that Giacomo ran the cited experiments or produced original model metrics.
Do not depict undocumented brain regions, neural topology, parameter counts, energy savings, AGI capability, or automatic retraining.
